Visibility and Tracking

Cảnh báo đến nơi

A real-time notification sent to designated parties when a shipment, container, or vehicle has arrived at a specified location such as a port, terminal, or customer site, as logged in transport documents or tracking platforms.

Quick answer: A real-time notification sent to designated parties when a shipment, container, or vehicle has arrived at a specified location such as a port, terminal, or customer site, as logged in transport documents or tracking platforms.

Questions and answers

What is Cảnh báo đến nơi?

In this glossary, Cảnh báo đến nơi refers to: A real-time notification sent to designated parties when a shipment, container, or vehicle has arrived at a specified location such as a port, terminal, or customer site, as logged in transport documents or tracking platforms.

How is Cảnh báo đến nơi used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Cảnh báo đến nơi được tự động gửi cho bên nhận và đại lý hải quan khi container đến cảng và được ghi nhận trên hệ thống theo dõi của hãng vận chuyển."

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A real-time notification sent to designated parties when a shipment, container, or vehicle has arrived at a specified location such as a port, terminal, or customer site, as logged in transport documents or tracking platforms.

Operational example

An arrival alert is automatically issued to the consignee and customs broker when a container arrives at the port and is registered in the carrier’s tracking system.

Localized term
